title: TraitSpaces: Towards Interpretable Visual Creativity for Human–AI Co-Creation
reasoning: The paper includes a 'Moral World' domain as a core component of its creativity framework. This domain specifically benchmarks traits such as 'Ethical Provocation,' which evaluates a work's capacity to confront audiences with complex moral dilemmas and injustices, and 'Collective Resonance,' which involves fostering empathy and solidarity.
